style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. Boxes have subtle shadows; labels in clean sans-serif; arrows are slightly curved with arrowheads. Architectural, calm, technical but human. Wide editorial aspect. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
image_prompt: An editorial illustration of a single, well-engineered production line shown as the centrepiece, built once and clearly solid. Several application products move along it on parallel tracks at the same time, each at a different stage of completion, tended by just one or two small figures. The emphasis is on the reusable line itself rather than any single product. A sense of front-loaded investment paying back across many outputs. Muted Alberta cream base with deep navy line work and small rust accents, archival print quality, no text, no logos. All text labels in es. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
